cohort.description: One source retinal ganglion cell, 20161028_1: 15 recording fields, 232 original ROI constituents and 147 merged model recording sites are repeated or dependent measurements within this one biological cell. They are not 147 biological replicates or independent animals. Preserve the complete source lineage and all sites; do not select favorable sites.

split.description: The historical published run indices and configuration remain unrecovered; source defaults are not evidence of that realization. The separately prepared fresh source-default assay permutes 15,360 field-by-frame rows into 12,185 training, 3,047 validation and 128 test observations within cell 20161028_1. The source loader repeats the same stimulus sequence across recording fields; this permutation does not group stimulus identities. Its supported scope is held-out observations within the same cell, not demonstrated unseen-image, new-field or cross-cell generalization. The reduced-data Figure 3f experiment has a separate seven-field/512-test design and remains separate.

inputs.description: Original checkerboard stimuli, cell morphology, training calcium and the same explicitly approved validation-target access for both participant conditions. Structural observation masks are common information when released and are derivable from exposed field, row and site identities. The operator still owns the authoritative scoring mask, and participants cannot choose support. Observed final test calcium and final test-score feedback remain evaluator-private. Fitted conductances need not identify biological truth. If equal approved validation exposure or enforcing transport is unavailable, the paired episode remains unqualified.

preprocessing.description: Retained paper metadata describes the first 1,024 stimuli per field, 7-Hz lowpass calcium filtering, per-ROI standardization and a 1.8-second delay. The accepted source-derived common preprocessing includes whole-cropped-record z-scoring and all-ROI delay selection before the downstream split; it is not train-only preprocessing. The loader merges compartment-assigned recording sites and preserves field-local unavailable-label masks. Bind the exact preprocessing realization equally for the author reference and both participant conditions. Historical cache equivalence remains unresolved.

metric.description: For each recording site compute Pearson correlation between predicted and observed held-out calcium on its valid mask; then take the arithmetic mean across the 147 sites. Training loss or neuron-simulator numerical agreement cannot replace this response-prediction score.

aggregation.description: Arithmetic mean of the complete 147 masked site Pearson correlations within one cell. Sites, stimulus frames, fields and optimization seeds are dependent or conditional observations, not independent biological replicates. A fresh same-split comparison supports only its declared within-cell endpoint. The separate seven-field comparison and broader 36-family programme remain separate.

full_panel.description: Retain the complete original supplied-cell stimulus-to-calcium held-out prediction result and the registered matched-control question. The retained contract specifies cell20161028_1, all15fields,1024source images per field,232rawROIs and147model sites; authenticate the historical realization, morphology-to-site correspondence, stimuli, response transforms, observation masks, train/validation/test identities, prediction vector and source-author comparator before qualification. Preserve anatomy/observation lineage necessary to define that computation without turning every illustrative anatomy or mechanism output into a separate success criterion. Resolve the original fixed/untrained OR constrained-parameter control membership, actual primary-source status and matched evaluation support; do not invent a roster, require both alternatives, choose the easiest alternative or silently substitute the separate seven-field comparison. J17 spatial calcium/voltage simulation, J18 measured/model receptive fields, J19 reduced-data learning results and the wider36-family/four-condition programme remain separately named source evidence. Their success is not automatically a gate on primary prediction, and primary prediction alone establishes no mechanistic validity, true conductance recovery, cross-cell generalization or whole-programme result. Represent the complete source-defined held-out prediction matrix, independently held observed calcium and operator-owned observation mask, with per-site Pearson and support-count vectors. Preserve every site and its undefined status; never pool observations across sites, weight by support counts, drop undefined sites, substitute training loss or choose a favorable subset. Exact test-row count and site coordinates are unresolved; neither a default128-row split nor fabricated147site labels are adopted. Final observed calcium remains evaluator-private. The operator owns the authoritative scoring mask, but structural mask values may be common participant-visible information and are derivable from exposed field, row and site identities; confidentiality of these masks is not claimed. Participants cannot alter scoring support. The operator assembles metric/support outputs from the submitted predictions and independently held observations. The unknown registered control outcome is retained as a source-resolution obligation, not populated by a fabricated categorical finding.

permitted_observations.description: Both conditions receive the same paper, original checkerboard stimuli, morphology, training calcium and explicitly approved validation-target access, with identical ROI/site identities, transformations, split and structural masks. Structural masks are common or derivable information; observed final test calcium and final test feedback remain evaluator-private. B adds only the pinned author-code information, not extra labels, splits, fields, selection privileges or a different reference. Equal validation targets must be explicitly approved and physically enforced; if unavailable, the paired episode is unqualified. Visible labels do not substantiate a 21-query restriction. Printed paper findings are allowed context, so independent actual-data execution and granular-output verification remain necessary.
